ei.subject: 수능특강 영어
ei.title: Relative Velocity and the Bullet Story

fullPassage: There is one important thing to note about momentum. Since motion is relative, only relative velocities are relevant. In fact, when you think about it, all velocities are relative. Thus, on the surface of the earth, we always reckon velocity with respect to the ground — the velocity of the earth itself does not matter. There is a true story of a French pilot in World War I who stretched his hand out of his small airplane window and caught a bullet. How is this possible? The velocity of the bullet must have been about the same as the velocity of his plane. This can happen, because a bullet slows down to such a velocity toward the end of its flight path due to the action of air drag. Since only relative velocity matters, the momentum of the bullet was negligible as far as the pilot was concerned. Thus, he would have had little problem in catching the bullet.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: neglect(동사) → negligible(형용사). was 뒤 보어 자리이므로 형용사 필요
det.tip: neglect(무시하다) → negligible(무시할 수 있는, 형용사). -ible: ~할 수 있는

questions.passage: There is one important thing to note about momentum. Since motion is relative, only relative velocities are relevant. In fact, when you think about it, all velocities are relative. Thus, on the surface of the earth, we always reckon velocity with respect to the ground — the velocity of the earth itself does not matter. There is a true story of a French pilot in World War I who stretched his hand out of his small airplane window and caught a bullet. How is this possible? The velocity of the bullet must have been about the same as the velocity of his plane. This can happen, because a bullet slows down to such a velocity toward the end of its flight path ____. Since only relative velocity matters, the momentum of the bullet was negligible as far as the pilot was concerned. Thus, he would have had little problem in catching the bullet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: due to the force of gravity pulling it down
because the pilot flew faster than the bullet
due to the action of air drag
because the bullet was fired from behind

det.korean: 총알은 비행 경로 끝에서 공기 저항의 작용으로 감속한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① due to the force of gravity pulling it down
❌ ② because the pilot flew faster than the bullet
✅ ③ due to the action of air drag
❌ ④ because the bullet was fired from behind
✅ ③ due to the action of air drag: 원문과 일치
❌ ①: 중력 아님 — 공기 저항
❌ ②: 조종사가 더 빠른 게 아님
❌ ④: 뒤에서 발사된 것과 무관
det.tip: air drag: 공기 저항(항력). 총알이 비행 끝에서 감속하는 원인

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the bullet traveled faster than the speed of sound
the momentum of the bullet was negligible as far as the pilot was concerned
the pilot needed special equipment to catch the bullet
air drag increased the bullet's velocity significantly

det.korean: 상대 속도만 중요하므로, 총알의 운동량은 조종사에게 무시할 수 있을 정도였다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the bullet traveled faster than the speed of sound
✅ ② the momentum of the bullet was negligible to the pilot
❌ ③ the pilot needed special equipment to catch the bullet
❌ ④ air drag increased the bullet's velocity significantly
✅ ② the momentum was negligible: 상대 속도 ≈ 0 → 운동량 무시
❌ ①: 음속보다 빠르다는 내용 없음
❌ ③: 특별한 장비 없이 손으로 잡음
❌ ④: 공기 저항이 속도를 증가시키지 않음
det.tip: 상대 속도 ≈ 0 → 상대 운동량 ≈ 0 → 총알 잡기 가능
